body: Chip four shipped. PR https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/logbook/pull/209, branch fix/store-ref-leads-disk-race, npm test 829 passed 0 failed exit 0, typecheck exit 0 three times. Decision recorded as 01M1V4BPZXF7Q1Z9D7AMSWQHZJ.U+000AU+000AThe architect overturned the brief's premise and neither offered option was chosen. The pick was to delete the whole-directory swap and materialise in place, with per-file atomic writes and a ref-guarded prune. Details are on the decision record.U+000AU+000AIndependent corroboration: the race was already filed in-repo as item S1 in docs/plans/2026-08-25-post-cutover-repair/FILED.md, with 9 hits across the complete 512-run CI history, 5 carrying the exact refusal text, clustered 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-02, and its proposed remedy is word for word what the architect reached independently. A 2026-08-27 scratch-swap attempt did not close it; 7 of the 9 failures landed after it.U+000AU+000AEvery test is deterministic with no sleep, timer, poll, retry or wall-clock read. The core case concurrent.the-opener-reads-back-a-record-that-landed-during-its-own-materialisation at test/store/concurrency.test.ts:496 was red on the parent with "expected a resolvable record, found none", and reached that assertion only after proving the competing writer had both committed and written to disk. The interleaving is forced by a fake git on PATH running the competing writer as a blocking spawnSync inside the ls-tree call the code under test must make — a subprocess call it cannot skip, not timing. Restoring the two renames turned it red again, and each of the four guards removed one at a time turned only its own test red.U+000AU+000AOne honest exception flagged on the PR: the record-name round-trip test takes the refusal arm on this machine because APFS folds case and the other arm on CI's ext4. A platform-independent test pinning the same guard directly exists, so the guard is covered on both.U+000AU+000AZero occurrences of the flake observed across three full suite runs, and the lead explicitly declined to offer three clean runs as evidence of a low rate.U+000AU+000ANot verified: CI has not run on this branch, so the suite passes locally only. The original ENOTEMPTY refusal has no red-before test, because the code path that raised it was deleted, so its absence is argued by construction rather than by a receipt; the lead accepted that over a lock design whose wedge-on-crash risk in a store the human cannot hand-edit is worse. Recovery from a disk failure mid-refresh is untested, and the fsync cost of per-file writes on a large store is unmeasured.U+000AU+000AIt overruled one reviewer finding, that a skipped prune leaves the store believing it is current: the stamp is written at the OLD ref while the live ref has moved, so the next open re-materialises. The architect ruled the same way independently.U+000AU+000AFiled and not folded in: a reaper for temp files orphaned by a killed peer; the removeEmptiedDirectories rmdir race with a concurrent materialiser; the dangling-symlink path where createStoreDirectories throws before the guard runs; an unlooped writeSync short write; a missing test for the directory-where-a-blob-is-needed collision direction; and MATERIALISE_SUBPROCESS_CEILING = 3, a pinned count this project's own testing rule classes as a change-detector. Separately, roughly 16,000 leaked logbook-* scratch directories under TMPDIR from other suites, now a chip; bulk deletion of the existing ones is left to the human.U+000AU+000AALL FOUR CHIPS ARE NOW SHIPPED. Open and unmerged: 206 rendering, 207 close_thread pins, 208 githook chain, 209 store materialiser. c1 and the documentation criterion are marked done. c3 is the only open criterion and needs the human's permission plus a plugin reinstall from merged main and a Claude Code restart, since the running server is still the 6.0.0 copy that predates every fix this session produced.
